title: 第22章 缝纫汉服
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
“歘——”

    花期拉开窗帘，站在全身镜面前，牵着一片式襦裙裙摆转了一圈。

    照相机在空中咔咔闪，疯狂对着镜子面前的裙子拍照。

    裙子是淡黄色，裙头没有任何秀花，只有裙摆上有几朵带着亮片的印花。

    “小助，快看看好看不？缺了绣花会不会太素了？”

    花期转了两圈在镜子面前停下，调整好对襟的位置，挽上白色披帛，在脑中呼叫小助。

    小助还在emo着，对她的呼唤只是抬起眼皮虚虚看了眼。

    【很漂亮，绣花我建议配上荷花】

    “你认真看了没？我裙摆的印花就是荷花好不好。”

    花期啧了一声，不指望小助了，提着裙子出门找到在阳台洗衣服的小花。

    “小花，快来看看我这件衣服好看吗？”

    人未到，声先至。

    兢兢业业洗衣服的机器人回头，便见一位穿着它从来没有见过的服装朝它走来。

    小花缓缓放下脏衣篓，屏幕上跳出两条波浪线，线又变成了一团乱麻，最后化为两个感叹号。

    “主人，按照我的运行程序，我这会儿该夸你才对，但小花没有见过这类衣服，给不出您准确的意见，很抱歉主人。”

    “没事儿没事儿，这叫汉服，是唐代的齐胸襦裙。你之前没看见过，现在就知道了。”

    花期摸了摸小花的铁脑壳，牵着裙摆，把上面的印花盖在裙头上。

    “我这里还缺图案，按照你数据库里面的分析，你觉得绣什么花看好？”

    小花盯着荷花看了两秒，数据终端飞快运行，最后一个虚拟图案投屏到花期胸前。

    “主人，我建议还是用荷花，粉红荷，和您裙摆的印花很适配。”

    “粉红荷吗？”花期对着小花的屏幕照了下，见真的很适配，她欣喜地点了下头，“是挺不错的，小花你真棒。”

    屏幕上跳出两团红晕，小花挠了下脑袋，“主人，您过奖了，这是小花应该做的。”

    “那你继续洗衣服，我接着回去设计。”

    花期又摸了下小花的铁脑壳，便回房间按照草稿纸的设计，将一匹半的云纱全部让缝纫机制成汉服。

    齐胸、齐腰、褙子、吊带、大袖、马面、百迭、三裥裙、战国袍等等...

    她在书房忙碌了一上午，一口气画了十张草稿图，也缝纫了十件不同朝代的汉服。

    一匹半的云纱，正好全部用光。

    剩下的边角料，则被用来当成披帛和霞帔。
content_en:
"昘——"

    Hua Qi opened the curtains, stood in front of the full-length mirror, and turned the skirt of her one-piece skirt in a circle.

    The camera flashed in the air, frantically taking pictures of the dress in front of the mirror.

    The skirt is light yellow, and there are no flowers on the skirt. There are only a few sequined flowers on the skirt.

    "Xiaosuke, let's see if it looks good? Will it be too plain without the embroidery?"

    Hua Qi turned around twice and stopped in front of the mirror, adjusted the position of her lapels, put on her white shawl, and called Xiaosuke in her head.

    Xiaosuke was still emoticon, and he just raised his eyelids and glanced at her call.

    [It’s very beautiful, I recommend adding lotus flowers to the embroidery]

    "Did you read it carefully? The print on my skirt is lotus, okay?"

    Hua Qi clicked her tongue and gave up on Xiaosuke. She picked up her skirt and went out to find Xiao Hua washing clothes on the balcony.

    "Xiaohua, come and see if my dress looks good?"

    Before anyone arrives, the sound comes first.

    The robot that was doing the laundry diligently turned around and saw a man walking towards it wearing a costume it had never seen before.

    Xiaohua slowly put down the dirty clothes basket, and two wavy lines jumped out on the screen. The lines turned into a mess again, and finally turned into two exclamation points.

    "Master, according to my operating procedures, I should praise you now, but Xiaohua has never seen this kind of clothes, so I can't give you an accurate opinion. I'm sorry, Master."

    "It's okay, it's okay. This is called Hanfu, a chest-length undershirt from the Tang Dynasty. You haven't seen it before, but you will know it now."

    Hua Qi touched Xiao Hua's iron head, held the hem of her skirt, and covered the top of her skirt with the print on it.

    "I'm still short of patterns here. According to the analysis in your database, what kind of flowers do you think are good for embroidering?"

    Xiao Hua stared at the lotus for two seconds. The data terminal ran quickly, and the last virtual pattern was projected onto Hua Qi's chest.

    "Master, I suggest you use lotus flowers. Pink lotus flowers go well with the print on your skirt."

    "Pink lotus?" Huaqi took a photo of Xiaohua's screen. Seeing that it really suited her, she nodded happily, "It's pretty good. Xiaohua, you're awesome."

    Two blushes appeared on the screen. Xiaohua scratched her head and said, "Master, you are very grateful. This is what Xiaohua should do."

    "Then you continue to wash the clothes, and I will go back to the design."

    Hua Qi touched Xiao Hua's iron head again, then went back to the room and used the sewing machine to make a Hanfu with one and a half pieces of cloud yarn according to the design on the draft paper.

    Chest-length, waist-length, bra, suspenders, big sleeves, horse face, Baidu, three-pleat skirt, Warring States robe, etc...

    She was busy in the study all morning, drawing ten sketches in one breath, and sewing ten pieces of Hanfu from different dynasties.

    One and a half pieces of cloud yarn were all used up.

    The leftover scraps were used as shawls and shawls.
